washington.destination_info: Most visitors arrive in summer (Jun–Sep) when the weather is mild and mostly dry. Winter through spring (Nov–May) tends to be cool and rainy. Local events include the Skagit Valley Tulip Festival (Apr), Seattle International Film Festival (May–Jun) and Bumbershoot (Sep), a music and arts festival held in Seattle.
